coaching.headline: Lost the tower trade 7–10 and won anyway — a 28/1 Drongo won 8 fights, and 6 of those wins cashed into a prize within 90 seconds, majors finishing 25–21.
coaching.team: This win came from the fights, not the structures: we went 8 won to 1 lost across the game's fights and cashed 6 of the 8 into a prize within 90 seconds, finishing 25–21 on majors. Now the honest part of the tower story: they out-towered us 10–7, but not off their fighting — they won exactly one fight all game. Their structure takes rode on our deaths — the death-cost log ties their outer towers, inner towers and inhibitors to deaths at 14.6, 17.1, 20.2, 27.1, 27.8 and 30 — and 7 of our deaths came outside any fight, caught rotating alone. Repeat the pattern that won it: fight on top of the prize and cash the win. The one sharpen: stop trading solo deaths for their structures — the two uncashed fight wins and the 7 caught-out deaths are the whole gap between a 36-minute grind and a clean close.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: Fight wins were converted and deaths were not free: 6 of our 8 won fights cashed into a prize within 90 seconds, while their tower lead rode on our deaths — the death-cost log ties their outer towers, inner towers and inhibitors to our deaths, 7 of them caught-out, outside any fight. Cut the caught-out deaths and the tower count flips with everything else.

perPlayer.10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Drongo carry, 28/1/2 — Willy Guggenheim was the win condition: 2-0 at their outer tower at 18.6, 3-0 at their inhibitor at 20.6 and again at 28.6 (that one modeled at 3 items online to their side's 11), 2-0 at our Orb Prime at 33.1, on top of 37403 objective damage. The only death, at 12.6, was outside any fight — the exact habit that fed their towers when others did it. Keep everything else.
perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Phase support, 2/0/26 — zero deaths in a support matchup that read theirs all game (Muriel), with 13 wards, 29241 healing and 20921 mitigated. That's the enabling behind a 28/1 carry — repeat it. One read from the fight log: the wins at 20.6 and 28.6 were opened 4v5 while Mr_Meat31 was pinned in a losing lane — when stuck like that, call it early so the team times its fights around the arrival instead of a body down.
perPlayer.a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Aurora jungle, 2/2/10 — Xeebs was the frontline: 46256 mitigated and 7 wards, in a jungle matchup that read Xeebs' way all game against Khaimera. The sharpen is that both deaths were the expensive kind: the 17.1 death preceded their outer tower, and the 20.2 catch preceded an inner tower, an inhibitor and a second inner tower inside 90 seconds. And at the 30.6 teamfight Xeebs was alive and ahead in lane — shove and rotate there turns the 4v5 the team opened into even numbers.

threats: Chain-CC risk (1 hard-CC abilities, ~0.5s of lockdown): Lt. Belica Neural Disruptor (silence 0.5s). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Iggy & Scorch Inferno (knockback). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
We have sustain (Phase) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Our damage is 4/5 magical — predictable; one magic-resist item answers most of it. Mix in a physical threat.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ultPlus: Necrosis (Matter Disruptor): Your Ultimate Ability deals 15% more damage.
lines: Lead story: Damage well above normal. 1,624 hero damage a minute, more than 95% of Drongo carry players this patch (32% of the team's). The damage came from Scattershot, Tainted Rounds, Imperator.
Necrosis (Necro's Edge): Gain 25 Ultimate Haste.
Necrosis (Matter Disruptor): Your Ultimate Ability deals 15% more damage.
Drongo dealt 58,459 hero damage, 32% of their team's, with +312 physical power from items.

Penetration: Vanquisher 12; against Muriel (level 16: about 104 physical armor, 92 after penetration; took 15,929 physical damage from heroes, 60% of all hero damage they took) and Khaimera (level 17: about 93 physical armor, 81 after penetration; took 15,420 physical damage from heroes, 47% of all hero damage they took) that is about 6% and 7% more damage (estimate: percent penetration taken before flat).
Scattershot (item): Upon successful On-Hit Attack: Summon 2 projectiles from the Target. These home towards the closest Enemies. Each deals (+40%) Damage. Applies On-Hit effects at 50% effectiveness.
Tainted Rounds (item): On Successful Basic Attacks: Reduce the Target's Healing by 45% for 3s. Deal (+10%) (+20%) Damage On-Hit. Increases by up to 100% as the Target's Health decreases.
Imperator (item): Critical Strikes deal 30% more damage.
Necrosis (item): Your Ultimate Ability deals 15% more damage.
Pacifier (crest): Dash a short distance. Empower your next Physical Damage Instance within 3s. Deals 30 (+25%) Damage. Increased by 2.5x against Targets below 20% Max Health.

Thraex (Eternal): Mark the last Enemy Hero damaged by your Basic Attack for 3s, increasing your damage against them by 3% (+0.4% per level) and reducing the damage they deal to you by 1.5% (+0.35% per level).
Bring The Boom (augment): Rad Rounds deals 60% of its damage to nearby Enemies upon exploding.

Sustain: 22% lifesteal; Terminus: On Overhealing from Lifesteal: Convert excess Healing into a Shield. Max Shield size: (+100%). The Shield slowly decays 15s after leaving combat.; Savage Strikes: Deal 1.5 (+0.4 per level) Physical Damage On-Hit. Attacking an Enemy Hero increases this by 100% for 3s, stacking up to 3 times. Heal for the damage dealt.; 3,296 healing recorded.

Loadout augment Bring The Boom: When Rad Rounds' stacks erupt on a target, part of that damage also hits enemies around them. Shoot the frontline during Rad Rounds to splash the group behind it. (game text: Rad Rounds deals 60% of its damage to nearby Enemies upon exploding.) (changes Rad Rounds, 12s cooldown with their haste) Field: 50% in 7609 games, 71% of picks, level the hero-role's 50.2%.

Loadout Eternal Thraex: Your basic attacks mark the target, so you deal more to them and take less back. Helps in duels against a single diver. (game text: Mark the last Enemy Hero damaged by your Basic Attack for 3s, increasing your damage against them by 3% (+0.4% per level) and reducing the damage they deal to you by 1.5% (+0.35% per level).) Field: 52.7% in 878 games, 8% of picks, above the hero-role's 50.2%.

Loadout minor Savage Strikes: Small extra damage and healing on each basic attack that grows while you keep hitting a hero. Fast attacks during Rad Rounds stack it quickly. (game text: Deal 1.5 (+0.4 per level) Physical Damage On-Hit. Attacking an Enemy Hero increases this by 100% for 3s, stacking up to 3 times. Heal for the damage dealt.) [1.5 + 0.4 a level: 8.7 at level 18] Field: 53.5% in 693 games, 79% of picks, above the hero-role's 50.2%.

Loadout minor Ferocity: Attack speed that keeps climbing the longer you stay in hero combat. Rewards Drongo shooting from safety through a long fight. (game text: Gain 1% Total Attack Speed per 1s in Hero Combat, stacking infinitely.) Field: 52.9% in 715 games, 81% of picks, above the hero-role's 50.2%.

Loadout crest Pacifier: A short dash that empowers your next hit, much stronger on low targets, and resets on a kill. Use it to reposition and finish a target your bleed has worn down. (game text: Adrenalize:  Dash a short distance. Empower your next Physical Damage Instance within 3s. Deals 30 (+25%) Damage. Increased by 2.5x against Targets below 20% Max Health. Killing a Hero within 3s allows Adrenalize to be recast for 6s.) Field: 51.3% in 7481 games, 70% of picks, above the hero-role's 50.2%.
Stack (Every basic attack set off): 4 effects on one trigger: Scattershot, Tainted Rounds, Thraex, Savage Strikes.
Stack (Healing off the damage): 3 effects on one trigger: Terminus, Pacifier, Savage Strikes.
The Eternal was part of it: Thraex (Savage Strikes + Ferocity) sits on the same triggers as the items (every basic attack set off; healing off the damage), so the same hits paid out twice.
Countered? 1 of the 5 players Drongo killed built physical armor (Greystone). Anti-heal on Khaimera. We killed Drongo 1 time.
Copy it? Thraex (Savage Strikes + Ferocity): 54.2% in 581 Drongo carry games, above the hero's 50.2%. Proven this patch: worth copying.
